scope: All remaining Phase 4 proposals assembled before further user questions

userInstructions.instruction: When a behavior is definitively based on Chakra/Radix, inspect and apply that reference instead of asking Peter again.
Put every remaining proposal together first; then go over actual unresolved questions.

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Simple Grid
referenceFollowthrough.result: No minimum-width clamp, component-level mode choice before responsive mapping, no declared columns=1 default.

referenceFollowthrough.subject: General Stack/Group
referenceFollowthrough.result: Column Stack and Group horizontal/center/.5rem defaults carried through selected house names/tokens.

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Scroll Area
referenceFollowthrough.coverage: Main examples and API text reviewed; not a new rendered interaction check
referenceFollowthrough.result: hover/always with hover default; remove imagined scrollHideDelay from this source contract

referenceFollowthrough.subject: FormatByte
referenceFollowthrough.coverage: Main component documentation and both complete source files
referenceFollowthrough.result: decimal/binary API; underlying decimal/byte/short/precision3 defaults and negative signs. Zero hardcoding and binary SI labels require correction/verification, not claimed source fidelity.

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Number Input
referenceFollowthrough.coverage: API properties, machine defaults/state transitions/effects through displayed source, complete utility file; not a complete new port audit
referenceFollowthrough.result: String value, numeric derived value, min/max safe integers, step1 or percent.01, scaled modifier steps, blur clamp/overflow/spin defaults; no imported machine

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Pin Input
referenceFollowthrough.coverage: API properties and complete machine source
referenceFollowthrough.result: Numeric/placeholder/otp defaults, array/string values, focus/paste/completion behavior; source UTF-16 operations are not a grapheme guarantee

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Hover Card
referenceFollowthrough.coverage: Complete main text and API available in output
referenceFollowthrough.result: 600ms open, 300ms close; supplementary-content accessibility limit; house explicit-activation rule for interactive rich help stands

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Toast
referenceFollowthrough.coverage: Targeted provider/API sections; not all 3329 example lines reread
referenceFollowthrough.result: limit3, timeout5000ms, timeout0 persistent, older items marked limited

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Disclosure/Tabs
referenceFollowthrough.coverage: Relevant API/mounting sections and examples; not a new full browser or Material pass
referenceFollowthrough.result: lazyMount=false, unmountOnExit=false; Accordion multiple/collapsible false; Tabs automatic activation

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Tooltip
referenceFollowthrough.result: Current source delayTime0 and LEAVE_MS100, carried as baseline rather than invented universal delay

referenceFollowthrough.subject: ComboBox
referenceFollowthrough.result: Enter commits a listed row or closes; noRawSelectedValue concerns supplied unmatched-value display, not free-form creation

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Markdown
referenceFollowthrough.result: Raw HTML false default and explicit trusted opt-in; ordinary links/images described as sanitized; no raw HTML sanitizer guarantee

referenceFollowthrough.subject: Table compact example
referenceFollowthrough.result: Normal .625rem block/.5rem inline; compact5px block with inline unchanged. Numeric density alternatives labelled proposed, not measured future output

converterProbe.behavior: defaultConverter catches malformed structured JSON and returns null; CSS scalar '[start] 1fr' also returns null when forced through Object conversion, supporting house scalar-first requirement.
converterProbe.scope: Pure Bun converter execution; not DOM/attribute lifecycle or house renderer verification.

designReconciliations: Separate value, open, expanded, visible and current notifications; completed copy/load/complete/dismiss results are not action requests.
Parent/child components keep a single value/form/keyboard owner; Group only supplies presentation.
Propose author-owned native Table/List/Data List content plus scoped generated document CSS.
Propose component-owned native light-DOM Markdown output for real heading fragments/TOC; no arbitrary private-shadow crawling.
Keep defaultValue/defaultChecked reset targets distinct from current programmatic value writes.
Map all old tags to a retained/rebuilt contract or replacement recipe; no alias implementation.
Source Pagination maps to DocNavigation; results Pagination is the separately selected capability.
Simple Grid numeric zero is explicitly a proposed house normalization, not a copied JavaScript truthiness quirk.
Named appearance input presence is tracked separately from effective inherited values; raw CSS getter rule remains unchanged.
limitations: Proposal assembly is not implementation, runtime fidelity or user approval.
The five questions and named interface/style/registry/form/accessibility gates remain.
No new full Material visual review is claimed; prior completed review is reused, and the Progress visual gap remains explicit.
Private Chakra Pro code remains in its existing private reference collection.
Additional public names/props/parts are proposals, not silently recorded user decisions.
